lines.name: l1
lines.text: Silverback gorilla versus grizzly bear. Who wins?

lines.name: l2
lines.text: The gorilla: around two hundred kilos, insanely strong, and explosive in short bursts.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: The grizzly: up to three hundred and sixty kilos, claws up to ten centimeters long, and thick fur and fat like armor.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: Pound for pound, the gorilla is stronger. But the bear is almost twice as heavy.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: On paper, the grizzly wins. Do you agree?
